# About the collection
**The MetaZoo Token**

Use your MetaZoo Games tokens to gain exclusive and early access to MetaZoo products before the rest of the community. Tokens may also be used to gain access to the whitelist for other MetaZoo NFT drops! The first of such offers include the highly anticipated MetaZoo x Dim Mak t-shirt drop and early access to MetaZoo: Cryptid Nation Base Set 2nd Edition in mid-December.
**A token-based NFT collection**

With the Veil between our world and all things magical mysteriously shattered, it is up to you to become a powerful enough Caster to fight the menacing Indrid Cold and his powerful Cryptids... or join their ranks! Will you form a Contract with the benevolent Bigfoot and Fearsome Critters to protect our forests, or embrace the flying catastrophe that is The Mothman? The choice is yours in MetaZoo: Cryptid Nation! This collection features 6 unique tokens which are the currency in the MetaZoo lore, each of which is representative of a special item or character in the MetaZoo universe.
**Errors and Bonuses**

During the minting process, certain errors occurred! These error tokens include a damaged Jersey Devil Purple token, a double stamped Mothman Gold token, and other eccentricities that are significantly rarer than their properly minted counterparts. These error tokens will only be circulated during the presale event.
**Long Term Utility**

These tokens are not one-time use! They can be redeemed at many future MetaZoo Games exclusive releases. Think of these tokens as your ticket into the VIP lounge at any major MetaZoo product release event. For product releases that usually sell out in minutes or even seconds, this exclusive access to product at MSRP or discounts to MSRP is essential for the true MetaZoo fan!
**A Look into the MetaZoo x Dim Mak Collab**

On 12.15.2021, MetaZoo Games token holders will have exclusive access to a presale at a discount to MSRP of the MetaZoo x Dim Mak collab drop! Each box contains a random MetaZoo Dim Mak design, a holographic promo card, and several hundred boxes will be randomly seeded with Nightfall 1st Edition, Base Set 1st Edition, and even Kickstarter booster packs! Available only on the Dim Mak Marketplace.
**A Look into MetaZoo: Cryptid Nation Second Edition**

On 12.31.2021, we finish 2021 strong with an exclusive presale of MetaZoo: Cryptid Nation Base Set Second Edition at a massive discount to MetaZoo Games token owners! This presale will be available only on the MetaZoo Marketplace. In 2022, MetaZoo Games will see the release of three core sets of its trading card game (TCG) plus mini-releases across dozens of other product verticals including a new Kickstarter launched in Q1, plushies, jewelry, figurines, more Topps products, and PinClub pins! MetaZoo Games token owners can expect to gain exclusive and early access to almost every drop! The value in these tokens is truly incredible for MetaZoo collectors of every variety!

# Minting Instructions
**Presale · 29 Nov, 11am EST to 2 Dec, 11am EST**

When the Presale Event starts, the connect-wallet functionality will be available on the website. You will need to connect your wallet by clicking the connect wallet button and, if you are part of the whitelist, you will be able to click the mint button and get MetaZoo Games Tokens. Detailed steps below:
- Step 1: Connect your MetaMask wallet to https://nft.metazoogames.com
- Step 2: Press the connect button and you'll be prompted to sign.
- Step 3: Select up to two tokens to mint depending on your whitelist eligibility.
- Step 4: Press Mint and you'll be prompted to sign your wallet address and confirm payment.
- Step 5: Once you confirm your payment you can follow the transaction on Etherscan; it can take up to 30 seconds and sometimes a little bit longer.
- Step 6: Congratulations! Once a successful purchase has been made you will be able to view them in your wallet or on OpenSea.io.
**Public Sale · 2 Dec, 12pm EST to 12am EST**

The Public Sale had a decreasing-price model and was available to everyone. The price started at 5 ETH and decreased by 0.1 ETH every 15 minutes for 12 hours. You could choose to mint anytime, as long as tokens were still available and the sale had not ended. Detailed steps below:
- Step 1: Connect your MetaMask wallet to https://nft.metazoogames.com
- Step 2: Press the connect button and you'll be prompted to sign.
- Step 3: Select the number of tokens you would like to mint at the current price.
- Step 4: Press Mint and you'll be prompted to sign your wallet address and confirm payment.
- Step 5: Once you confirm your payment you can follow the transaction on Etherscan; it can take up to 30 seconds and sometimes a little bit longer.
- Step 6: Congratulations! Once a successful purchase has been made you will be able to view them in your wallet or on OpenSea.io.

# MetaZoo is an IP

Starting as a trading card game (TCG) dealing with cryptids such as Bigfoot, Mothman, and the Chupacabra, MetaZoo has seen a meteoric rise in popularity in less than a year from the release of its first set of cards, Cryptid Nation. Since then, MetaZoo has been featured in Topps, Walmart, Pinclub, Sotheby's, and many other AAA brands!
... are just the beginning. MetaZoo already has hundreds of characters, and these first 5,000 PFPs are based on our first 3 sets.

With 3 sets being introduced each year, 1,000 new PFPs will be minted with each set, introducing our completely new characters. The catch? You can mint a new set's PFPs only if you own one of these original PFPs! What's our next set, you ask...?
# Utility is KING

MetaZoo Games has already trailblazed NFT backed utility with our unique tokens. From early access to exclusive product, to the Allow List for this very PFP drop, MetaZoo Tokens have provided some of the most consistent benefits in the industry... but we want to take it further. It's 2022, even PFPs should have an associated utility. So, once again, let's make history!

In collaboration with our partners, each year a new set of collectible cards will be released reflecting both the art of the PFPs, as well as their rarities. What's the catch? The catch is... these will only be available for purchase by those who own a PFP! Each year's set of collectible cards will reflect those PFPs released for that year's sets (for instance, the first set of collectible cards will have PFPs from Cryptid Nation Base Set, Nightfall, Wilderness, UFO, HiROQUEST, and Seance!).

MetaZoo's first venture into NFTs, marketed at the time as Genesis 2021: seventeen cryptids drawn in a 16-bit animated style and sold through a Mintable store across March 2021, months before the Coin Tokens drop.

The sale opened on 7 March 2021 with ten Mothman Contracts and ran cryptid by cryptid for the rest of the month. The format varied: some were seven-day auctions opening at $0.99 (Squonk Baby and the NYC Sewer Alligator, 25 each), others sold at a flat price, with the River Dino listed at $4.99. Supply ran from 10 of the scarcest up to 100 of the most common.

**These were not free mints, but the chain cannot price them.** Mintable settled the sales off-chain, so the tokens were minted to the store's own wallet and delivered to buyers in transactions carrying no ETH. Every claim transfer reads as 0 ETH, which is why no primary revenue appears here. Only the opening prices survive, in MetaZoo's own announcements; the amounts buyers actually paid are not recoverable from any public source.

947 Genesis tokens were minted on-chain (595 on the dedicated contract, 352 more inside the shared Mintable store), but **116 of them never left MetaZoo's own store wallet**, so roughly 831 reached collectors. Almost all of the unsold remainder is a single block of 110 Piasa Birds: MetaZoo advertised 100 of that cryptid and minted 210, and 104 of the extras are still sitting where they were minted. Every other cryptid sold through at 97% or better.

That gap is why the re-issue does not line up with the mint count. The 2023 airdrop sent 890 editions, close to the 875 MetaZoo advertised and to the 831 that actually sold, rather than to the 947 minted. Unsold inventory got no airdrop.
Genesis holders were the ecosystem's first adopters, and the collection later earned a re-issue and a serialized promo card of its own.
The second PFP generation, and the collection this project is named after ('Nftina', the electric cat MetaZoo introduced as its NFT mascot alongside this drop).

**It was claimed, not sold.** The PFP boxes that shipped from 11 December 2022 contained black booster packs holding scratch-off cards, and the codes on those cards were what unlocked a PFP 2.0. The claim itself ran on Manifold as a free mint, so buyers paid only gas, and on-chain primary revenue is just 1.19 ETH (roughly $2,000) in mint fees. The real cost was the $100 box.
The artwork drew on the Seance, UFO and Native sets, and 2,381 were claimed before the redemption window closed in August 2023.
MetaZoo never wrote a real description for it. The official copy on the mint page reads, in full: "Welcome to MetaZoo's PFP 2.0 Seri- ... *Meow* ..."
It arrived as MetaZoo's on-chain activity was already contracting, and it trades today at a floor far below what the boxes cost.

off_chain_basis.note: PFP 2.0 was not a normal on-chain mint. Holders first ordered a $100 physical 'MetaZoo NFT PFP Box'; inside was a redemption for the PFP plus a small on-chain mint fee. The on-chain primary revenue (about $2k) captures only that mint fee, so it badly understates what holders actually paid. Measured from the real $100 box price against the current floor, a PFP 2.0 is far deeper underwater than the on-chain number suggests.

overview: A small Valentine's-themed ERC-1155 set (token IDs 1 to 6). The same contract also holds the Wilderness Pinclub tokens (IDs 7 to 11), so the two drops share an address but are counted separately here.

**The physical set and the NFT are a year apart.** MetaZoo released the 2022 Chibi Valentine's mini-set on 7 February 2022 with a print run of 25,000 boxes, and Coin Token holders who bought a $30 box were promised a Valentines NFT for each purchase. Roughly 1,200 of the 2,305 Coin Tokens were redeemed against those boxes. The NFTs themselves were not minted on-chain until February 2023.
Economically negligible: roughly 0.4 ETH (a few hundred dollars) of lifetime volume across the whole contract.

off_chain_basis.note: MetaZoo Valentines was sold off-chain: holders paid about $30 to mint, with only a trivial on-chain fee ever recorded. Measured from that real $30 price against the current floor, a Valentines piece is far underwater on what holders actually paid, not the near-zero the on-chain mint fee implies.

overview: Seventeen updated-art cryptid tokens re-issued on OpenSea's shared storefront and airdropped to earlier holders, mirroring the seventeen cryptids of the original 2021 Genesis run (Mothman, Jersey Devil, Sinkhole Sam and the rest).

Nothing was sold: recipients paid nothing, so primary revenue is zero. Unlike the one-per-token original, these are ERC-1155 editions, and the 890 pieces here are edition counts rather than distinct artworks. That 890 tracks the roughly 875 Genesis tokens MetaZoo advertised and the 831 that actually reached collectors, not the 947 minted: the 116 Genesis tokens still sitting in MetaZoo's own store wallet received no airdrop.

The distribution ran for eleven months, from August 2022 to June 2023, rather than as a single snapshot: 638 sends to 265 wallets. Matched against what each recipient held at the moment their airdrop arrived, 824 of the 890 editions went to wallets holding Genesis at the time, another 26 to wallets that had held one earlier and sold in the meantime, and 40 to wallets that never held one, most of those holding Coin Tokens or Beasties instead. Only 13 editions reached wallets with no MetaZoo history at all.
About 38.9 ETH (roughly $62,000) of secondary volume and 1.79 ETH (about $4,500) of royalties have flowed through them since.
Holders of a re-issue token were later offered the Neo Genesis promo, an exclusive serialized physical card matching the Genesis NFT they held.
Steve Aoki's own creator contract (deployed 17 Jul 2021), included here because it holds the MetaZoo-linked 'Mothman' 1/1 (token #1017) that sold at Sotheby's for roughly $214k.
This is not a MetaZoo-issued collection; it is an Aoki artifact that intersects the MetaZoo story through the Mothman piece and its cryptid IP.
MetaZoo Wilderness (Pinclub) is a small five-token ERC-1155 set (IDs 7 to 11) sharing its contract with the Valentines drop.

It accompanied the Wilderness set, released 14 March 2022, and the $150 Pin Club case that Coin Token holders could buy: each case came with an exclusive promo card and a Wilderness NFT airdropped per purchase. MetaZoo put the NFT-label Wilderness box run at around 2,800 to 3,000, and capped the token-holder presale at two boxes per Coin Token.
On-chain activity is minimal: the Wilderness tokens trade rarely and for small amounts, and combined Valentines plus Wilderness volume is roughly 0.4 ETH (a few hundred dollars).

off_chain_basis.note: The Wilderness Pin Club drop carried an off-chain mint price around $150, far above the negligible on-chain fee. Against the current floor, that $150 cost basis leaves holders deeply underwater on what they actually paid.

overview: Three gifted one-of-one trophies (first, second and third place) from the MetaZoo Games New Year's Tabletop Simulator tournament, minted on the shared OpenSea storefront.

The prizes changed shape before they shipped. MetaZoo first announced a spinning-coin token for third place, a one-of-one Bronze Snowman, in December 2021, then scrapped that design and gifted these trophies instead. Winners were announced on 2 January 2022, and the tokens were not minted until 1 February 2022.
As gifted prizes they had no public primary sale, so on-chain primary revenue is zero and secondary activity is minimal.

The MetaZoo Mothman is a one-of-one (token #1017) from the Steve Aoki x Gal Yosef collaboration, created 20 September 2021. It was MetaZoo's second NFT project and became the most valuable object in the ecosystem.

It sold in a Sotheby's auction running 14 to 21 October 2021, the first NFT ever sold on Sotheby's then-new Metaverse platform. The winner also received a matching one-of-one Mothman promo card, the only one ever printed, and 100 booster boxes of Cryptid Nation: Nightfall 1st Edition.

The Sotheby's lot page pins the numbers: a final bid of $170,000 (bidder ak09) plus Sotheby's 26% buyer's premium, for a sold price of $214,200. Sotheby's kept the premium, roughly $44,200, plus any negotiated seller's commission.
The auction settled off-chain: every on-chain transfer of the token, including the move to the winner, carried no ETH, so no price is recorded on the blockchain itself.
Six 3D voxel characters (Sam Sinclair, Space Penguins, Chupacabra, Mothman, Loveland Frogman and White Thang) built for The Sandbox, minted 22 July 2022 on The Sandbox's shared ASSET contract.

Primary sales settled in SAND on The Sandbox marketplace, off the ETH pipeline entirely. On-chain ETH secondary volume is negligible: only a couple of the six have ever changed hands, for a fraction of an ETH.

They did not ship alone. They arrived inside Steve Aoki's wider Sandbox collection, which went live on The Sandbox Marketplace on 25 September 2022 beside his own avatars, sneakers, gold records and jet, and buying any asset from it granted a Collector Badge worth 30 SAND. Aoki's Playhouse appeared in Sandbox Alpha Season 3 the same season.
The 1,050 pieces are edition counts across the six characters (200 each, except White Thang at 50), not 1,050 distinct artworks.
